title: is_closed() check on empty-batch disconnect is correct and consistent
description: Using is_closed() rather than a no-op send() to detect disconnect in the close_after_first=false empty-batch path is the right call. A no-op send() would needlessly wake the receiver-side stream consumer. The TOCTOU between is_closed() returning false and the next send() call is benign: the next send() catches the disconnect. This is better than forcing a spurious wakeup just for symmetry.
